item.title: ‘Then, you are not Gen Z?’ Delhi High Court’s light-hearted exchange with CJP leaders; Dipke reacts
item.description: During a hearing, the Delhi High Court engaged in a light-hearted exchange about Generation Z with Cockroach Janta Party leaders. The court questioned the legal approach taken by the petitioners against the custody extension issued by a Special Executive Magistrate. Concerns were raised about possible violations of prohibitory orders related to protests as well. The petitioners ultimately withdrew their plea after expressing worries about the outcomes of their surety reconsideration.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: ‘Get your facts straight’: BJP accuses Rahul Gandhi of hypocrisy over RSS remarks on women’s rights
item.description: Bharatiya Janata Party officials criticized Congress leader Rahul Gandhi for his recent statements about the RSS. They accused him of hypocrisy regarding women's respect based on his behavior towards women. BJP spokesperson CR Kesavan emphasized Gandhi's failure to address allegations against a Congress MP involved in harassment. Additionally, BJP MLA Ram Kadam challenged Gandhi's understanding of the RSS's women's wing.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: 'Damning photos': Opposition leaders question Hardeep Puri's alleged meeting with Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: Leaders from Congress, TMC, and NCP have voiced strong disapproval of Hardeep Singh Puri for his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein. Puri has contended that his interactions came during a professional delegation after his ambassadorial tenure. Critics are calling for clarification about the substance of these encounters, emphasizing their concerns over the ramifications of Puri's associations with someone linked to serious criminal charges.
item.dc:creator: Aastha Jha

item.title: ‘Was it necessary?’ Anupam Kher slams Uttarakhand BJP minister over Daler Mehndi row
item.description: Anupam Kher expressed his disappointment with BJP's Uttarkhand minister Subodh Uniyal's treatment of singer Daler Mehndi on stage. During a cultural event, Uniyal called out Mehndi for allegedly lip-syncing and questioned his sobriety. Kher emphasised the importance of addressing concerns privately to maintain dignity and respect. Singer Mika Singh defended Mehndi, citing his health issues and denying alcohol consumption allegations.
item.dc:creator: Ayush Pandey

item.title: More trouble for CJP leaders: Another FIR against Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka transferred to Crime Branch
item.description: Delhi Police has transferred two FIRs against Cockroach Janta Party leaders to the Crime Branch for investigation. The leaders, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, were detained during protests at Connaught Place and Jantar Mantar. Legal challenges have been filed by their team to contest an extension of their judicial custody. They claim their continued detention violates their fundamental rights and due process.
item.dc:creator: Yashasvi Vasistha

item.title: After HM visit CBI team begins investigations into killing of anti-drug activist, CBI registers FIR
item.description: A team from the Central Bureau of Investigations arrived in Mansa to investigate the murder of Parwinder Singh Jhota. The investigation was prompted by demands from Jhota's father and a local action committee for justice. Union Home Minister Amit Shah visited the bereaved family and assured them of justice before the CBI's arrival. The CBI is expected to collect evidence pertinent to the case and conduct a thorough investigation.
item.dc:creator: Neel Kamal

item.title: 'My journey began with Ramleela': Ravi Kishan portrays Lord Ram during Dussehra celebrations in Delhi
item.dc:creator: Aastha Jha

item.title: Jhota murder case: CBI takes over Punjab anti-drug activist killing case, files fresh FIR
item.description: The Central Bureau of Investigation has registered a case regarding the murder of Parvinder Singh Jhota. Jhota was shot dead inside a medical store in Punjab's Mansa while hosting a Facebook Live session. Following demands from his family, Chief Minister Bhagwant Singh Mann announced the case's transfer to the CBI. Union Home Minister Amit Shah welcomed this decision but criticized the state government for not addressing other drug-related cases.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: Delhi high court cites national security, junks CIC order to IAF on PMs’ foreign trips
item.description: Allowing a petition by the Central Public Information Officer of Directorate of Personal Services, Air Headquarters, Justice Amit Mahajan held the IAF was justified in denying access to the records under section 8 of RTI that exempts disclosure of information that could jeopardise national security or pose a risk to a person’s life and physical safety.

item.title: India & United States to boost defence, energy ties, Marco Rubio says trade deal close
item.description: Rubio’s second visit to India comes against the backdrop of the US’s Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act, which is intended to penalise countries purchasing Russian oil, and Trump’s subsequent temporary suspension of related tariffs. India maintains that its oil procurement is essential not only for its own energy security but also for the stability of global markets. Rubio lauded the “substantial progress” made by India in diversifying its energy portfolio.
item.dc:creator: Sachin Parashar

item.title: Police lens on Lawrence Bishnoi’s aide Randeep Malik in Tiger Shroff shooting case
item.description: Anil Pandit Pandit and Shroff ’s shooter Rehan both reported to Malik and were considered “his men” till a few months ago, a source said. Rehan had been earlier tasked by Malik and Pandit with a shooting incident in Sonipat as well. “Rehan was shown the same ‘American dream’ that Malik had shown Pandit in the past,” a source said.
item.dc:creator: Raj Shekhar Jha

item.title: Allahabad HC cites long trial, lets off offenders, SC slams ‘misplaced sympathy’
item.description: A bench of Justices J B Pardiwala and K Vinod Chandran said it was a case of misplaced sympathy. The trial court had awarded fiveyear jail terms to the two, but the HC released them on probation. SC said the case was “doomed from its inception insofar as justice delivery to the victim is concerned”.
item.dc:creator: Amit Anand Choudhary

item.title: India, US ‘perfectly aligned’ on key issues: Marco Rubio; defends ties with Pakistan
item.description: Addressing a gathering of India Inc’s leading business figures, Rubio said the relationship between the two countries could help shape the future of the global economy, particularly as advances in artificial intelligence and quantum computing transform industries and societies. “I truly believe the relationship between US and India is defining, in many ways, in a positive way, what the 21st century can look like,” he said.

item.title: In talks with Reliance to refine more Venezuelan oil: US secretary of state Marco Rubio
item.description: US secretary of state Marco Rubio is visiting Jamnagar Wednesday to tour the Reliance refinery and, in a lastminute change of schedule, is likely to spend the night there. He was earlier scheduled to leave around 9pm and return to Mumbai. In Jamnagar, he will have dinner with Mukesh Ambani at the Vantara centre. Rubio’s visit to Jamnagar comes within weeks of a vicious attack on Ambani by Elon Musk.
